text: Si Alla meminirii ma -an Nulaaɗo- jarrabuyee, a ɗaɓɓii huncaneede ɗum, alaa huncanoowo ma ɗum si wanaa Kanko Seniiɗo on. Si O faandike e maaɗa yaajeende, hay gooto haɗataa ɓural Makko ngal. Himo meminira ɓural Makko ngal on Mo Muuyi e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, alah baawnoowo Mo. Ko Kanko woni Haforanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
